get.description: This method returns some basic information system e.g., GraphDB version, disk space, attached repo
Returns LexOLexica statistics split by named graph and unchanged NIF corpus/text statistics

post.description: This method returns a paginated list of the attestations stored for one text, including observable display labels, per-text frequencies, and NIF locus data; optional query parameters filter by the exact observable, observable type, or creator, while an optional JSON filter supports nested AND/OR conditions on attestation creators, text metadata, and observable types; attestation descriptions are not included

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: id of the text whose attestation graph must be queried

parameters.name: observable
parameters.description: optional exact IRI of the observed lexical entity whose attestations must be returned

parameters.name: observableType
parameters.description: optional RDF type IRI used to filter the observed lexical entities

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: optional dct:creator value used to filter the attestations

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: optional maximum page size; defaults to 50

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: optional zero-based page offset; defaults to 0

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: optional nested AND/OR filter tree; observable, observableType, and author query parameters are combined with it using AND

post.description: This method creates multiple FRAC attestations for one lexical entity and corpus in a single batch, stores their NIF loci in LexOTexts, and increments the observable frequency for each specific text

parameters.name: observable
parameters.description: IRI of the observed ontolex lexical entry, form, lexical sense, or lexical concept

parameters.name: corpus
parameters.description: IRI of the text or corpus where the value was observed

parameters.name: external
parameters.description: true when corpus is an external HTTP or HTTPS resource

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: the account that is creating the attestation (if LexO user management is disabled)

parameters.name: occurrences
parameters.description: JSON list of occurrences; every item requires value, start, and end

post.description: This method returns a paginated list of one observable's attestations with their per-text frequencies across all document graphs; an optional JSON filter supports nested AND/OR conditions on attestation creators, text metadata, and observable types

parameters.name: observable
parameters.description: IRI of the observable whose attestations must be queried

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: optional maximum page size; defaults to 50

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: optional zero-based page offset; defaults to 0

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: optional nested AND/OR filter tree

delete.description: This method atomically deletes selected attestations, or every attestation, of one observable from a per-text graph, updates the affected observable frequencies, and removes orphan loci generated by the attestation service

parameters.description: id of the text whose attestation graph must be updated

parameters.name: deletion
parameters.description: observable and either all=true or a non-empty attestation IRI list

patch.description: This method atomically replaces the inverse frac:attestation link for one or more attestations in one per-text graph and recalculates the old and replacement observable frequencies

parameters.description: id of the text whose attestation graph must be updated

parameters.description: replacement observable IRI and a non-empty attestation IRI list

post.description: This method creates one FRAC attestation for every supplied lexical entity at a shared textual locus, writes each entity's optional common RDF metadata on its own attestation, and updates every observable frequency for the specific text

parameters.name: corpus
parameters.description: IRI of the text or corpus where the lexical entities were observed

parameters.name: external

parameters.description: the account that is creating the attestations (if LexO user management is disabled)

parameters.name: locus
parameters.description: JSON object containing the required value, start, end, and a non-empty list of observable objects with optional common RDF metadata
